objective: Standard statement: for a three-fold odd gadget whose dual H (with the corner line L) is a connected 3-regular triple system that is not 2-colourable, prove (1) lambda(0) = (-1)^(n-1) A(H, L), where A(H, L) is the number of 2-colourings of H - L with L fixed to one colour; (2) a point lemma: for a point p on lines l1, l2, l3, the colourings of the rest with l_i seeing the complemented value at p number A(H, l_i); (3) factorization: across a tight cut whose leaf-side piece B has an amplitude independent of the corner, A(H, L) = A(B) A(H/B, L), so A(H) is the product of its braces' amplitudes and independent of L whenever every brace's is; (4) brace amplitudes: the Heawood graph 5, the doubled square 1, a planar brace with its Kasteleyn signing the number of Tutte matchings of its dual trinity, which is Tutte's tree-trinity number (Kalman's hypertree count; the spanning trees of M for an omnitruncation of M); (5) corollaries: |lambda(0)| = 5^genus when the glue is doubled squares, and in general 5 per Fano atom times Tutte's number per planar brace. Nearest known result: Tutte 1948 (tree trinity); Kalman 2013; Kalman-Postnikov 2017; Mathews 2017 (survey); SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: the knot's exactness factor on a three-fold space is (-1)^(n-1) times 5 per Fano atom times Tutte's tree-trinity number per planar glue brace (6 per trisum of three cubes); point lemma, factorization over tight cuts, brace amplitudes
title: Five per handle, Tutte's number per planar piece
